300.title: EUROMETAL Steel Trade Day 2026: Polish steel market struggles with structural changes in demand
300.summary: EUROMETAL Steel Trade Day 2026: Polish steel market struggles with structural changes in demand 26 November 2026 Despite the resilience of the Polish economy and considerable investment potential in infrastructure, energy and defence, the country’s steel consumption remains subdued.
300.body: EUROMETAL Steel Trade Day 2026: Polish steel market struggles with structural changes in demand 26 November 2026 Despite the resilience of the Polish economy and considerable investment potential in infrastructure, energy and defence, the country’s steel consumption remains subdued. The growing disconnect between economic growth and steel demand reflects structural changes in the manufacturing sector rather than a temporary economic downturn, Metal Expert learnt during EUROMETAL Steel Trade Day 2026, held on November 23-24 in Duesseldorf, Germany. Polish steel consumption is expected to reach 13-13.5 million t in 2026, remaining broadly in line with the previous year’s level and around 2 million t below its historical peak, according to Piotr Sikorski, President of the Polish Union of Steel Distributors and Processors (PUDS).

400.title: Poland meets 76 of 77 EU RFF targets, but offshore wind ports fall short
400.summary: Brussels, 20 November 2026 On Friday, the European Commission partially greenlighted Poland’s sixth and final payment request for €12.7 billion under the Recovery and Resilience Facility , the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU. The Commission found that Poland has satisfactorily completed 76 out of 77 milestones and targets set out in the Council Implementing Decision .
400.body: Brussels, 20 November 2026 On Friday, the European Commission partially greenlighted Poland’s sixth and final payment request for €12.7 billion under the Recovery and Resilience Facility , the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU. The Commission found that Poland has satisfactorily completed 76 out of 77 milestones and targets set out in the Council Implementing Decision . The payment to Poland for the already greenlighted milestones and targets can take place following the EFC’s positive opinion and the subsequent adoption of a payment decision by the Commission. With a view to the closure of the Recovery and Resilience Facility at the end of 2026, Members States had to implement all outstanding milestones and targets by the end of August 2026 and submit final payment requests by the end of September 2026.

500.title: OpenAI's pricing mix-up means most users of its new AI models will hit limits faster
500.summary: Now that it's been fixed, most users can expect to hit their usage limits 40% and 25% faster on Astra and Sol, respectively, for doing the same tasks, Sottiaux said in his early-morning post on Thursday. Sottiaux said OpenAI wouldn't retroactively charge users for the difference in past usage with the new models, which both launched on November 17.
500.body: The company made a billing mistake that "incorrectly discounted" GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol earlier this month, Thibault Sottiaux, the engineering lead for Codex, OpenAI's coding agent, said on X. Now that it's been fixed, most users can expect to hit their usage limits 40% and 25% faster on Astra and Sol, respectively, for doing the same tasks, Sottiaux said in his early-morning post on Thursday. Astra is OpenAI's newest frontier model for the most difficult tasks, whereas Sol is cheaper and for everyday tasks, according to OpenAI's website. Sottiaux said OpenAI wouldn't retroactively charge users for the difference in past usage with the new models, which both launched on November 17.
